blocks.text: Mobile Home Parks: how mobile and manufactured homes work here

items.t: What the page is: a Fraser-Valley-wide manufactured home park directory page titled "Mobile Home Communities | Fraser Valley," headed "Discover affordable mobile home parks in the Fraser Valley" — a name-and-address directory only, grouped loosely by community, with "View all [community] mobile homes for sale" links for Abbotsford, Chilliwack, Langley, Mission and Surrey. The heading word "affordable" is a page claim with no price/rent/comparison source cited: Not verified.

Geographic scope as listed: Abbotsford, Agassiz/Kent, Chilliwack, Coquitlam, Cultus Lake, Soowahlie, Hope, Langley, Maple Ridge, Mission, Rosedale, Ruskin and Surrey — wider than the Fraser Valley board area alone, since it includes Coquitlam and Maple Ridge.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect park-home buyers

items.t: Strata block (bare-land strata communities only): Form B (within 7 days, max $35 + up to 25¢/page); depreciation 5-year cycle, 5+ lots, since July 1, 2024; CRF minimum 10% since Nov 1, 2023; rental bylaws void since Nov 24, 2022; only 55+ valid since Nov 24, 2022 (SPA ss.123.1/123.2 + Reg 7.01 + May 1, 2023 exemptions); 45+ void, never converts.

blocks.text: The rules for buying in a park
Pad tenancy, park-owner consent, pad-rent caps and the Manufactured Home Registry are explained on their own page.

faq.a: The figure that matters is the specific park's current rent in its written Manufactured Home Site Tenancy Agreement.
faq.q: How much is pad rent in Fraser Valley parks?

faq.a: 2.3% + proportional (2026); 2.2% + proportional (2027), once per 12 months, 3 full months' notice, no rounding up, no carry-forward.
faq.q: How much can pad rent rise?

faq.a: On a rented pad, no: you own the home (a chattel) and rent the pad; the site right is the assigned tenancy under the MHPTA.
faq.q: Do I own land when I buy a park home?

faq.a: Yes — prior written consent under s.28 (Form 10, 10th-day response, deemed consent on silence, no consent fee), and the pad rent + next increase date carry over unchanged.
faq.q: Does the park have to approve my purchase?

faq.a: 73 entries in page order, covering Abbotsford, Agassiz/Kent, Chilliwack, Coquitlam, Cultus Lake, Soowahlie, Hope, Langley, Maple Ridge, Mission, Rosedale, Ruskin and Surrey — with Cedar Grove and Mountainview Estates in Chilliwack each listed twice, so the distinct count is lower, and the list is site copy only because no official park registry exists.
faq.q: How many mobile home parks does this page list?

faq.a: Under MHPTA s.42 the landlord must first have all required government permits and approvals, give 12 months' notice, and pay $20,000 on or before the effective date; the tenant may leave early on 10 days' notice, has 15 days to dispute, and may be eligible for additional compensation of the assessed value minus $20,000 through dispute resolution.
faq.q: What happens if the park is sold or converted to another use?
